theme: Shamian, Canton Tower, Beijing Road in the evening
pace: Taxi / metro per leg; no full-day car

food.name: Yinji Rice Rolls (银记肠粉)
food.desc: Original shop on Wenchang North Road. Shrimp rice rolls, beef rice rolls.

food.name: Ng Zham Kee (伍湛记)
food.desc: Jidi congee (及第粥) with fried dough sticks (油条)

items.title: Hotel → Shamian
items.note: Taxi, ~10–15 min. Navigate to “沙面大街”. The morning is spent on foot on the island; no further rides needed.
items.tip: Shamian is quiet in the morning; arriving after 9 is best for photos.

items.title: Shamian Island walking route
items.note: The island is small and the route is a loop; easy to follow.

route.title: Shamian Street (沙面大街)
route.desc: From the drop-off, walk along Shamian Street, the island's central avenue, lined with large banyan trees.

route.title: European-style buildings (欧陆建筑群)
route.desc: Former consulates, trading houses and banks from a century ago, each with a plaque at the door. Best spot for photos.

route.title: Our Lady of Lourdes Chapel (露德天主教圣母堂)
route.desc: Small cream-white church; photos from outside are enough.

route.title: Bronze statues (铜像雕塑)
route.desc: Many life-size bronze figures stand on the streets. Kids can hunt for them and pose with each; whoever finds the most wins.

route.title: Shamian Park (沙面公园)
route.desc: Small park with lawns and benches; kids can rest and run around.

route.title: Pearl River promenade (珠江边步道)
route.walk: Head south to the riverside on Shamian South Street
route.desc: A slow walk along the river, watching the Pearl River and passing boats.

route.title: White Swan Hotel lobby (白天鹅宾馆大堂)
route.walk: At the end of the riverside promenade
route.desc: See the lobby's “故乡水” (Homeland Waters) garden and river views; no purchase required. Lunch is here or nearby.

items.title: Lunch: Shamian
items.note: Eat early; depart for Canton Tower at 12:45.

food.name: Jade River at the White Swan Hotel (白天鹅宾馆 玉堂春暖)
food.desc: Inside the hotel; dim sum with river views. Booking recommended.

food.name: Shamian Island cafés (沙面岛咖啡馆)
food.desc: Several cafés and Western restaurants on the island; light meals.

food.name: Shamian riverside Western restaurants (沙面江边西餐厅)
food.desc: Around Shamian South Street; outdoor seating facing the river.

items.title: Shamian → Canton Tower
items.note: Taxi from the White Swan Hotel entrance, ~25 min. Navigate to “广州塔”. The afternoon is on foot until Huacheng Square, where the next ride is taken.

items.title: Canton Tower, Haixin Bridge, Huacheng Square
items.note: All on foot, from the south bank of the Pearl River to the north bank.

route.title: Canton Tower observation deck (广州塔登塔)
route.desc: Lift to the observation level; all of Guangzhou seen from over 400 m. Tickets should be bought in advance via official channels.
route.tip: Visibility is poor on overcast days; check the weather before leaving. Tickets are best bought in advance via official channels.

route.title: Bubble Tram on the tower top (塔顶摩天轮)
route.walk: Follow the signs on the observation level
route.desc: A Ferris-wheel ride that circles the top of the tower; a kids' favourite. Separate ticket required; queue times vary on the day.

route.title: Haixin Bridge (海心桥)
route.walk: ~5 min walk from the tower to the bridgehead
route.desc: Pedestrian bridge across the Pearl River, ~10 min to cross. The best Canton Tower photo is taken looking back from the bridge.
route.tip: Windy on the bridge and riverbank; bring a jacket.

route.title: Huacheng Square (花城广场)
route.desc: Guangzhou's new central axis, flanked by the Zhujiang New Town towers.

route.title: Dessert
route.walk: Enter Mall of the World (花城汇) via the underground entrance at Huacheng Square
route.desc: Afterwards, a taxi is taken from the mall entrance.

food.name: Crêpe and waffle shops at Mall of the World (花城汇可丽饼、松饼店)
food.desc: Made fresh and hot; right for winter.

items.title: Hotel → Beijing Road
items.note: Taxi, ~20 min. Navigate to “大佛寺”. The rest is on foot around Beijing Road.

items.title: Beijing Road: Dafo Temple, shopping, dinner, dessert
items.note: All stops are within a 5–10 min walk of each other.

route.title: Dafo Temple (大佛寺)
route.desc: May already be closed by early evening. Go in if open; otherwise take photos at the gate.

route.title: Ancient road ruins (千年古道遗址)
route.walk: ~5 min walk to Beijing Road Pedestrian Street
route.desc: Under glass panels in the middle of the street, road surfaces from the Song to the Ming and Qing dynasties can be seen.

route.title: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street (北京路步行街)
route.desc: Arcade buildings, malls and brand stores; lively at night.
route.tip: Crowded at night; belongings should be watched.

food.name: Roast squab, Portuguese chicken (烧乳鸽、葡国鸡)
Wai Yu Lau Teahouse (惠如楼)
food.desc: Old teahouse on Zhongshan 5th Road; go here instead for Chinese food.

route.title: Dessert
route.desc: Afterwards, a taxi is taken from the roadside on Wenming Road.

food.name: Baihua Desserts (百花甜品)
food.desc: Heritage dessert shop on Wenming Road

food.name: Black sesame soup, almond soup (芝麻糊、杏仁糊)
